prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a polished professional identity exploration board for a developer learning app named Relay. Landscape 3:2 board, warm off-white background, excellent precise graphic design. FOUR distinct logo directions arranged in a spacious 2x2 grid. Each quadrant shows a large simple vector-like symbol, the exact wordmark 'Relay' in clean contemporary humanist sans serif beside it, and a tiny dark-slate rounded-square app icon beneath using the same symbol. Small quadrant labels exactly '01  Handoff', '02  Signal', '03  Connection', '04  Relay R'. Direction01: two offset circular nodes connected by one short stepped diagonal line, intentional asymmetry, knowledge passing between people. Direction02: two minimal interlocking rounded right-angle strokes forming a forward moving signal, no wifi arcs. Direction03: two opposing open rounded links creating a central negative-space passage; distinctive geometric compact silhouette. Direction04: a highly simplified abstract capital R built from a continuous rounded route and exactly two endpoints, recognizable R silhouette. Every symbol must be genuinely different. Consistent restrained pale blue #91c9f7 and graphite #1c2935 palette. Large symbols dark graphite on light background; app icon symbols pale blue on dark slate. Flat solid shapes only, robust at 16px, rounded ends, professional and understated. No gradients, glow, shadows, 3D, glass, books, play triangles, infinity symbols, arrows everywhere, stock network mesh, decorative illustrations or presentation devices. Clean restrained typography and generous white space. Include no other copy or invented words. These are exploratory logo mockups, not a finished app interface.
